issue_context.title: Multiple Datapoints not detected as entities.
issue_context.body:
### The problem

Hi, 
I upgraded my API Plan to "advanced" because I would like to log the solid fuel consumption and the temperatures of our layered buffer. 
However, after upgrading and reloading the integration only 3 new entities showed up (16 in total). I checked the diagnostics-file and it shows the datapoints I am interested in. 

Datapoints: 
heating.buffer.sensors.temperature.top
heating.buffer.sensors.temperature.bottom
heating.buffer.sensors.temperature.midTop
heating.buffer.sensors.temperature.midBottom
heating.configuration.fuel.need

They don't seem to be mentioned in the log file. 

Our heating system is a wood burner so I guess no one needed these datapoints before?

### What version of Home Assistant Core has the issue?

core-2025.2.3

### What was the last working version of Home Assistant Core?

core-2025.2.3

### What type of installation are you running?

Home Assistant OS

### Integration causing the issue

vicare

### Link to integration documentation on our website

https://www.home-assistant.io/integrations/vicare

### Diagnostics information

[config_entry-vicare-01JKXCF8M2AB0KTA9A5RV2H267 (1).json](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/18788432/config_entry-vicare-01JKXCF8M2AB0KTA9A5RV2H267.1.json)

[home-assistant_vicare_2025-02-13T18-09-31.532Z.log](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/18788434/home-assistant_vicare_2025-02-13T18-09-31.532Z.log)

Well, that is not so common, yes.

@Majofi01 if you don't mind [add your device](https://github.com/openviess/PyViCare?tab=readme-ov-file#more-different-devices-for-test-cases-needed) to the python lib.

`heating.bufferCylinder.sensors.temperature.top` only exposed for heat pumps
`heating.bufferCylinder.sensors.temperature.bottom` only exposed for heat pumps
`heating.bufferCylinder.sensors.temperature.midtop` not exposed yet
`heating.bufferCylinder.sensors.temperature.midbottom` not exposed yet
`heating.configuration.fuel.need` this is by now only exposed for pellet boilers

**PLease make sure you configure the integration with `type: auto`**, currently logs say it is configured/detected as gas heating device.

Well, we had the [same issue with FuelCells](https://github.com/openviess/PyViCare/pull/304) where devices were detected as `GazBoiler` because it had the same role `type:boiler`. I'll fix that in the library. Anyhow, none of your sensors are exposed for your device type yet. We need to look into that.
